name: Turn update when voiding a ticket

steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "5727"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('5', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('7', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('2', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('7', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
And I click on the queue "HAIR" button
Then I should see the employee "Jessica" in the employee list
And I should see Employee "Jessica" with "C = 0.0" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the "Gel X" service
When I add the "Gel X" service to my cart
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I select the service "Gel X" in my cart
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I pay the exact amount by "Cash"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')

Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true })
Expect "toBeHidden" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I click on the queue "Hair" button
Then I should see the employee "Jessica" in the employee list
And I should see Employee "Jessica" with "C = 1.0" in the employee list
When I select the "TURN DETAILS" tab
When I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the text "Technicians" visible
And I should see the text "Hair" visible
When I click on the "Hair" button

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Round' }) })

Expect "toHaveText" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Round' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-label')

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Turn' }) })

Expect "toHaveText" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Turn' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-label')
When I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the first ticket of payment "27.11"
When I reopen to void ticket with payment amount "$27.11"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$27.11' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$27.11' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$27.11' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
And I should not see the employee "Jessica" in the ticket list
When I click on the queue "HAIR" button
Then I should see the employee "Jessica" in the employee list
And I should see Employee "Jessica" with "C = 0.0" in the employee list
When I select the "TURN DETAILS" tab
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the text "Technicians" visible
And I should see the text "Hair" visible
When I click on the "Hair" button

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Round' }) })

Expect "toHaveText" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Round' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-label')

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Turn' }) })

Expect "toHaveText" locator('tr.MuiTableRow-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiBox-root').filter({ hasText: 'Jessica' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-root').filter({ has: locator('.MuiChip-icon').filter({ hasText: 'Turn' }) }).locator('.MuiChip-label')
